title: Beauty’s stackable packaging is making a cool comeback
summary: Although not a new concept, stackable beauty compacts are gaining traction once again, with brands such as Prada Beauty, Jordana Ticia, Nudestix and SimiHaze all investing in the format as a way to deliver more personalisation and play in packaging

extraction.key_fact: 뷰티 브랜드들이 개인화와 재미를 제공하기 위해 스택형 컴팩트 패키징 형태에 다시 주목하고 있다.
